The wall coping on both sides of the gate joins continuously with the incoming coping; no tall standalone terminal posts hiding behind a new pasted gate, no added wings at a different height. Keep the entire original scene outside this gate junction and all outer image edge colors, roads and wall stubs precisely unchanged. The background is OPAQUE painted olive grass and ochre road matching the input, not transparent: this is a seamless replacement crop. Draw crisp native slate roof tiles, fine stone joints, wood portcullis and grass at high resolution1536x1024; preserve the exact130:87 logical scene framing, without zooming out or stretching the architecture.
